deferred.characters: All meshes, rigs, appearance variants, textures and materials.
deferred.construction_pieces: All construction geometry and its materials/textures. Latest instruction defers construction; do not assume the earlier mine construction exception authorizes importing structures now.
deferred.wall_and_fence_families: Wall/fence/gate objects and their associated materials await the wall and fence drawing tool workflow in a later chat. Mine construction remains identifiable as its own family.
deferred.openable_furniture: Drawer/cupboard assemblies and their separate moving components. Use the existing solid versions instead.

organization: Sort by functional category, retain source provenance, and track import status independently of category.
atlas_plan: Implemented for this approved batch. Deferred families have not been atlased or imported.
tracking_rule: After an actual Unity import, record source asset ID, destination asset path, GUID, status and date. Never mark an asset imported merely because it exists in the review blend.
known_source_issue: Character_Female_01 texture is missing from the download; character assets are deferred.
workspace_constraint: Runtime assets and permanent import tooling are in the Unity project. Source extraction, review renders and working intermediates remain outside the repository.
